title: Round-trip identity — atomic image, id-only image-src (post-sideload preferred shape)
_comment: WP-Q05 (14-fixtures-harness.md §7). An e-image widget whose `image` prop carries an image-src with `id` only (NO `url`) — the preferred shape after media.sideload_url (R9 id-XOR-url, image-src-prop-type.php:36-44). build → get_structure → normalize(both) → assert structural equality. The attachment id (24) is the dev-site fixture media id; the round-trip test re-IDs the ELEMENT id structurally (C2/R5) but the attachment id inside image-src.value.id is content and is preserved verbatim. _cssid stripped; empty sibling keys dropped. Run as ADMIN (content-sanitizer exempt). prefilter.verdict:defer (image prop is non-trivial; PHP dry_run authoritative).
